description: Runs the Jedi Outcast JK2MV (Multi Version) dedicated server on Pterodactyl. The image ships only the JK2MV engine and JK2MV's own free assetsmv.pk3/assetsmv2.pk3 - the operator must upload their own legally owned Raven Jedi Outcast base assets (assets0/1/2/5.pk3) to /home/container/base. installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server

: "${COPYRIGHT_ACKNOWLEDGED:=false}"
if [[ "${COPYRIGHT_ACKNOWLEDGED}" != "true" ]]; then
  printf '[ERROR] COPYRIGHT_ACKNOWLEDGED must be true. This egg does not distribute Raven Jedi Outcast assets.\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p \
  /mnt/server/base \
  /mnt/server/logs \
  /mnt/server/config

SERVER_CFG=/mnt/server/base/server.cfg
if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_CFG}" ]]; then
  cat > "${SERVER_CFG}" <<'CFG'
// Default JK2MV server.cfg created by the JK2MV egg installer.
seta sv_hostname "^7JKN^1|^7JK2MV Server"
seta rconPassword "change_me"
seta sv_maxclients "16"
seta sv_privateClients "0"
seta sv_pure "1"
seta mv_serverversion "1.04"
seta g_log "server.log"
seta logfile "2"
map ffa_bespin
CFG
  printf '[INFO] Wrote default %s\n' "${SERVER_CFG}"
else
  printf '[INFO] Existing %s preserved\n' "${SERVER_CFG}"
fi

printf '[INFO] You MUST upload your legally owned Jedi Outcast base assets to /home/container/base before starting the server:\n'
printf '[INFO]   assets0.pk3 assets1.pk3 assets2.pk3 assets5.pk3\n'
printf '[INFO] JK2MV-specific assetsmv.pk3 / assetsmv2.pk3 are provided by the runtime image and copied in on first start (only if missing).\n'
printf '[INFO] The JK2MV runtime entrypoint installs jk2mvded into /home/container on first start; no JK2MV binary is downloaded by this installer.\n'

variables.name: Copyright Acknowledged
variables.description: Required acknowledgment that you legally own the Jedi Outcast base assets you upload into /home/container/base. The runtime refuses to start without these assets. The image never distributes copyrighted Raven assets.

variables.name: Server Config
variables.description: Name of the server config file inside /home/container/base, passed to the engine via +exec. The JK2/Quake3 engine resolves this relative to the active fs_game directory (base/).

variables.name: JK2MV Server Version
variables.description: Multi-version protocol the JK2MV server advertises. Use 1.04 for the modern default; 1.02 / 1.03 for legacy compatibility; auto to let JK2MV negotiate.

variables.name: Extra Startup Args
variables.description: Optional additional arguments appended verbatim to the dedicated server command line after +exec ${SERVER_CONFIG}. Use +set style cvars (e.g. "+set sv_fps 40").
